C1383.title: Gigabyte Motherboard Firmware Backdoor Controversy
C1383.summary: A prominent security firm identified a vulnerability in Gigabyte motherboard firmware that could be considered a backdoor, potentially allowing attackers to exploit the firmware flaw for malicious operations. The finding drew widespread attention, and Gigabyte subsequently issued a response.
